geometry: A white five-point star on transparency, drawn as a continuous path with straight sloping edges and gently softened tips. Native canvas is 22 by 22 pixels; the star reaches all four canvas edges.
limitations: The continuous edges and subtle tip curves approximate the antialiased source; exact edge coverage at native size may differ. Inspected the SVG rendering at 8x. Position and scale were tuned against the original; the updated 8x rendering was inspected.
